forced_actions: Hidden x86 CDB with memory-only DirectDraw proxy and host ReadProcessMemory capture.
Base harness forces DirectInput acquisition return values, menu/load-slot0 logical coordinates, button flags, selection/accept returns, and fast-forwards startup sleeps.
Unit_Attack route is forced after scanning units, moving attacker coordinates beside defender, setting dword_51d01c=1, and injecting CPU-register arguments plus a synthetic return.
Prebattle dialog raw mouse coordinates and predicate return are forced into its first choice; raw coordinates are restored after return.
Arena width fields temporarily forced to17/20 with seven rows; camera fields forced outside limits before direct clamp calls.
Unit0 coordinate word temporarily forced to(0,3), (19,3), and (10,3) before direct camera recenter calls.
Original arena16x7, camera(0,0), unit0 coordinate word and CPU state restored before capture; redraw and tile projection are guarded against fixture state.
